description: The bar chart compares the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60, while the horizontal axis displays the four categories. For each category, two bars are shown: a light gray bar for NatSQL and a dark blue bar for TA-SQL. In the Simple category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 60.21, and TA-SQL has an accuracy of 63.14. In the Moderate category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 39.64, and TA-SQL has an accuracy of 48.60. In the Challenging category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 32.32, and TA-SQL has an accuracy of 36.11. In the Total category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 51.35, and TA-SQL has an accuracy of 56.19. The chart indicates that TA-SQL consistently achieves higher execution accuracy than NatSQL across all categories.
